# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities using [GitHub private reporting](https://github.com/netseye/passport-memo/security/advisories/new). If it is unavailable, open an issue requesting a private contact without disclosing exploit details. Include affected commit, impact and a sanitized reproduction through the private channel.

Do not publish credentials, transcripts, Flash dumps or device identity. For ordinary bugs, use public issues. See [data and security](../docs/security.md) for current design boundaries.
